title: Spoiled Casting
summary: The Cult keeps spare moulds in the Magma Vault. Tamsin can crack them where they stand, if somebody holds the floor round her while she works.

steps.journal: The Magma Vault, the Cinderworks' second floor: hold five waves while Tamsin spoils the moulds.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Magma Vault

ready: The Cult's spare moulds are cracked through. Tell Tamsin it's done; she'll say she knows.
done: Nobody casts anything out of those moulds again. Tamsin is insufferable about it.
